annotations.title: Prepare a service or price change

description: Stage a change to the owner's services and prices. action add (title required; kind service or item, default service; price_cents with price_kind fixed or hourly, or price_kind not_listed; optional description, section, duration_minutes; location_id or every open location), update (service_id from get_owner_content and only the fields to change) or remove (service_id). Rows from a connected system are edited there. Returns intent, expires_at and consequence; confirm_update_service applies it after approval. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: update_service
title: Prepare a service or price change
